title: Wathe Train Utilities
description: A basic datapack which adds a bunch of utilities to the Wathe (Harpy Express) mod by Doctor4t.
body:
# Wathe Train Utils 🚂
A Minecraft Datapack addon for the [Wathe](https://modrinth.com/mod/wathe) mod by Youtuber Doctor4t, previously known as *'The Last Voyage of the Harpy Express'*, a murder mystery-style modpack.
This Datapack adds a few utilities that help make sessions easier to manage/handle.

## Features:
 - Adds 2 custom goat horns:
   > Conductor's Horn - Queues a Game-Start on use, 20s delay with use
   > Teleporter's Horn - Teleports all players to you on use, single-use
 - Adds Conductors - players who have the Conductor's Horn, they have 
   the ability to start games, even without operator permissions. They also have access to acquire the Teleporter's Horn.
 - Adds Train Watchers - players who are exempt from the Teleporter's Horn (intended to allow people to remain outside the train to spectate / take a break)
 - Adds Interaction stations - a means to become a conductor/train watcher, using interaction and display entities. To place in world, use the appropriate create_interaction_station function.
 - Adds configurability with scoreboards:
   - Maximum number of Conductors,
   - Game-Start Queue Duration,
   - No. of Fake-Players spawned using the debug function __summon_carpet_bot__ [REQUIRES CARPET TO WORK]

And More planned eventually!

**If you find any errors, issues or potential new features, please create a note in the issues tab, or DM me on Discord!**

---
All credits for the original mod go to [@doctor4t](https://modrinth.com/user/RAT) and their [YT](https://www.youtube.com/@doctor4t)

The datapack is of my own devising, with suggestions made by friends (shout out [@rosedotpng](https://modrinth.com/user/rosedotpng) o/)
